description.value:
You've spent long hours studying the natural world. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in the Nature skill, or expertise in it if you're already proficient. You also learn the toxin scan tech power, which you can cast once using improvised, scavenged supplies — without a wristpad and without spending tech points — regaining the ability to do so after a long rest.
